answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. Consider a ledge at the center, a voyage resting nearby, and a river beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
